messages:
olivia: Hey infra team — kicking off a quota/project approval for a short pilot. Need 16 x A100-80G in us-west2 for project `redwood-pilot-23`. Also need an increase of 50 external IPs for NAT/egress. Billing host is `billing-7744`. Can someone start the GCP quota flow and verify org policy blockers? cc @sam @jordan

sam: Got it. Can you paste the project number + org ID? Also do you already have a service account that will own the requests, or should infra create one?

olivia: Project number is 987654321012. Org ID is 112233445566. We created `svc-pilot-provisioner@redwood-pilot-23.iam.gserviceaccount.com` and granted Compute Admin. I can add the billing admin if needed.

jordan: Heads up — our org policy `restrictAcceleratorTypes` is applied on most pilot org folders; it might block A100s. If that triggers we'll need a policy exception ticket. If blocked, fallback plan is to try L4s (lower perf) or request explicit allow for `A100-80GB`.

sam: Thanks. Two quick checks you can run while I open the ticket: list current regional quotas and accelerators. Example:
```
gcloud compute regions describe us-west2 --project=redwood-pilot-23 --format="yaml(quota)"
```
This shows current GPU accelerator quota lines. Also run:
```
gcloud compute project-info describe --project=redwood-pilot-23
```
Send outputs here so I can attach to the approval.

olivia: Pasted outputs into a GDrive doc: https://go/reports/redwood-pilot-23/quota-check (internal). Summary: CPU/ram OK, current accelerators for us-west2 = 0/limited, external IPs = 8/8 (hence need 50).

devops-bot: infra-approvals-bot created ticket INFRA-4521 for quota increases (A100 + external IPs). Link: https://go/infra/INFRA-4521 :white_check_mark:

jordan: Also confirm network design — are you planning Shared VPC + NAT gateway in host project or per-project NAT? If host project NAT then we may need to request more ephemeral egress from the host's quota (and coordinate with networking).

olivia: We planned host-project NAT (shared-vpc-host). Host project is `redwood-net-host`. I'll add the network owner (anna-network) on the ticket.

maria: Heads-up from finance — 16 x A100-80G on-demand baseline estimate ~= $Xk/day (we'll post exact). For pilot please consider mixing preemptible instances or using short-burst Dedicated commit instead of full-on on-demand. If this is for benchmarking, please add expected runtime & concurrency to the ticket so we can recommend cheaper config.

sam: Opening the org-policy exception request in parallel. If policy blocks, exception path usually takes ~2 business days with security signoff. If you can tolerate L4 fallback, say so here.

olivia: We can tolerate an L4 fallback for initial tests but final perf target requires A100. For now mark priority high and include fallback. Runtime estimate: 4 hours/day for 7 days, ~200 concurrent GPU-minutes/day during bench.

infra-approvals-bot: Quota request submitted to Google Cloud console under ticket GC-78902. Expected GCP turnaround 24-72 hours for accelerator quota, 1-2 hours for external IP increases if network-approved.

sam: I approved the internal infra step and attached the project/service-account/billing proof to INFRA-4521. Next: @anna-network to confirm host NAT capacity and @security to review org-policy exception if needed.

olivia: Thanks — pinging anna & security in the ticket. Will update if GCP responds or if we need alternate region (us-west1). :thumbsup:

jordan: FYI if we need quicker capacity we have limited L4 capacity in us-central1 that can be used as temp fallback. I'll send an inventory snippet to the ticket.

olivia: Cool, closing loop here — will update ticket with cost-approval doc and expected test schedule.

last: sam: Marking thread resolved for now. Follow-ups tracked in INFRA-4521 and GC-78902.
